Senses.Explanation: The after-seeing follow-up of the Chan test exchange: the asker splits the occasion at a meeting, and the answer shows whether anything changed. Fenyang Shanzhao splits the Niutou question in the old shaman-and-medium key — the shaman needs the shamaness to finish the rite, and after the seeing an old temple gets inscribed over by a threadbare scholar — Sixin Wuxin grades Touzi's paired answers closed-door housekeeping and recasts the exchange as his own: purple mist billowing before the meeting, a model for the people of the world after it, Danxia Zichun answers with the golden chrysanthemums suddenly open and mobbed by bees before, the sprout withered and flowers gone with nothing to lean on after, and Liao'an Qingyu gives the hundred-foot well below Mount Huayin before and the ten-thousand-year pine on Zhurong's peak after, refusing the plea to go past both roads. Yu'an Zhiji hides the poison tiger deep in the mountains before the meeting and bares the snake nests in the shallow grass after, then sets sun rising in the east and night falling in the west over seeing and not-seeing alike, Shanhui Huan answers Lingyun's peach-blossom question with the same verdict before and after — the alms bowl cannot escape two soakings — Yezhu Fuhui returns one gain, a whole stretch of joy, to the before-half, the after-half, and seeing-and-not-seeing alike the same words again, and Yingshan Zhiyin chains his word-play from brows parting in eight to ridge on ridge of green mountains seen, then to the after-seeing follow-up — put it down — before demanding one word beyond the mountains and waters.
